arxiv-2207-05509.title: Hybrid Physical-Neural ODEs for Fast N-body Simulations
arxiv-2207-05509.creator: Denise Lanzieri, François Lanusse, Jean-Luc Starck
arxiv-2207-05509.description: Abstract We present a new scheme to compensate for the small-scales approximations resulting from Particle-Mesh (PM) schemes for cosmological N-body simulations. This kind of simulations are fast and low computational cost realizations of the large scale structures, but lack resolution on small scales.

arxiv-2211-02228.title: Quantum Man-in-the-middle Attacks: a Game-theoretic Approach with Applications to Radars
arxiv-2211-02228.creator: Yinan Hu, Quanyan Zhu
arxiv-2211-02228.description: Abstract The detection and discrimination of quantum states serve a crucial role in quantum signal processing, a discipline that studies methods and techniques to process signals that obey the quantum mechanics frameworks. However, just like classical detection, evasive behaviors also exist in quantum detection.

arxiv-2302-01350.title: How to determine the branch points of correlation functions in Euclidean space II: Three-point functions
arxiv-2302-01350.creator: Markus Q. Huber *, Wolfgang J. Kern *, Reinhard Alkofer *
arxiv-2302-01350.description: Abstract The analytic structure of elementary correlation functions of a quantum field is relevant for the calculation of masses of bound states and their time-like properties in general. In quantum chromodynamics, the calculation of correlation functions for purely space-like momenta has reached a high level of sophistication, but the calculation at time-like momenta requires refined methods.

arxiv-2402-18966.creator: André Kowacs and Michael Ruzhansky
arxiv-2402-18966.description: Abstract . We prove sufficient conditions in order to obtain a sharp Gårding inequality for pseudo-differential operators acting on vector-valued functions on compact Lie groups. As a consequence, we obtain a sharp Gårding inequality for compact homogeneous vector bundles and compact homogeneous manifolds.

arxiv-2411-07838.title: Two-scale density of almost smooth functions in sphere-valued Sobolev spaces: A high-contrast extension of the Bethuel-Zheng theory

arxiv-2411-07838.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Elisa Davoli, Leon Happ. In this paper we prove a strong two-scale approximation result for sphere-valued maps in L 2 ​ ( Ω , W 0 1 , 2 ​ ( Q 0 , 𝕊 2 ) ) L^{2}(\Omega;W^{1,2}_{0}(Q_{0};\mathbb{S}^{2})) , where Ω ⊂ ℝ 3 \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} is an open domain and Q 0 ⊂ Q Q_{0}\subset Q an open subset of the unit cube Q = ( 0 , 1 ) 3 Q=(0,1)^{3} .

arxiv-2502-15429.title: Pub-Guard-LLM : Detecting Retracted Biomedical Articles with Reliable Explanations
arxiv-2502-15429.creator: Lihu Chen, Shuojie Fu, Gabriel Freedman, Cemre Zor, Guy Martin, James Kinross, Uddhav Vaghela, Ovidiu Serban, Francesca Toni
arxiv-2502-15429.description: Abstract A significant and growing number of published scientific articles ends up being retracted. Many of these retracted articles continue to be cited and influence research or clinical decisions, posing serious societal threats. In this paper, we propose Pub-Guard-LLM , the first large language model-based system tailored to retraction detection for biomedical scientific articles.

arxiv-2509-19466.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rodrigo Tenorio, Alexandre Toubiana, Tristan Bruel, Davide Gerosa, Jonathan R. Gair. We investigate the joint mass-redshift evolution of the binary black hole merger rate in the latest gravitational-wave detection catalog, GWTC-4.0. plos-pone-0002714.description: PLOS ONE research article. Many aspects of development, tumor growth and metastasis depend upon the provision of an adequate vasculature. This can be a result of regulated angiogenesis, recruitment of circulating endothelial progenitors and/or vascular trans-differentiation. The present study demonstrates

pmc-11357037.title: Visible-Light-Induced Diselenide-Crosslinked Polymeric Micelles for ROS-Triggered Drug Delivery
pmc-11357037.creator: Xinfeng Cheng, Huixian Li, Xiaomeng Sun, Tianxu Xu, Zhenzhen Guo, Xianchao Du, Shuai Li, Xuyang Li, Xiaojing Xing, Dongfang Qiu, Spyridon Mourtas
pmc-11357037.description: To synthesize an effective and versatile nano-platform serving as a promising carrier for controlled drug delivery, visible-light-induced diselenide-crosslinked polyurethane micelles were designed and prepared for ROS-triggered on-demand doxorubicin (DOX) release. A rationally designed amphiphilic block copolymer, poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(diselenolane diol-co-isophorone diisocyanate)-b-poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG-b-PUSe-b-PEG), which incorporates dangling diselenolane groups within the hydrophobic PU segments, was initially synthesized through the polycondensation reaction.

pmc-11398894.title: External Validation of Serologic Scores for the Detection of Liver Steatosis Among People With HIV
pmc-11398894.creator: Carlotta Riebensahm, Julia Brocker, Annalisa Berzigotti, Huldrych F Günthard, Philip E Tarr, Hansjakob Furrer, Andri Rauch, Gilles Wandeler, Bernard Surial, Swiss HIV Cohort Study
pmc-11398894.description: BackgroundFatty liver index (FLI) and hepatic steatosis index (HSI) are serologic scores used to detect liver steatosis. However, their diagnostic performance in people with HIV (PWH) remains unclear. We performed an external validation of FLI and HSI in the Swiss HIV Cohort Study.

pmc-11491953.title: Cognitive Function After Stopping Folic Acid and DHA Intervention: An Extended Follow-Up Results from the Randomized, Double Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial in Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
pmc-11491953.creator: Dong Bai, Junting Fan, Mengyue Li, Cuixia Dong, Yiming Gao, Min Fu, Qianfeng Liu, Huan Liu
pmc-11491953.description: Background:Our previously randomized controlled trial (RCT) showed daily oral folic acid (FA), docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) and their combined treatment for 6 months could significantly improve cognitive function in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) individuals.Objective:This study aimed to evaluate whether this benefit seen in the treatment group would sustain after stopping intervention when patients returned to a real-world.

pmc-11533327.title: Are asymmetric designs of tibial components superior to their symmetric counterparts for constrained condylar total knee arthroplasty using metal block augmentation?
pmc-11533327.creator: Ryosuke Kabu, Hidetoshi Tsushima, Yukio Akasaki, Shinya Kawahara, Satoshi Hamai, Yasuharu Nakashima
pmc-11533327.description: PurposeIn total knee arthroplasty (TKA), asymmetric tibial components have been developed alongside symmetric tibial components to enhance bony coverage at the tibia. In primary TKA and revision TKA for patients with significant bone defects, augmentation is employed to fill the bone defect.

pmc-11596227.title: Association between Ventilation Disorder and Masticatory Dysfunction in the Korean Adult Population: A Cross-Sectional Study Using Data from the 2019 Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
pmc-11596227.creator: So-Yeong Kim, Sun-A Lim
pmc-11596227.description: Background and Objectives: Respiratory and periodontal diseases are among the most common diseases affecting humans worldwide. Periodontal disease is a risk factor for aspiration pneumonia and other respiratory diseases. However, the evidence supporting the link between respiratory and periodontal disease is inconclusive and insufficient. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the relationship between oral disease symptoms and respiratory diseases.

pmc-13099124.title: An In vitro assessment of the genotoxic potential of short-, medium-, and long-chain triacylglycerides
pmc-13099124.creator: Sydney Schreppler, Nikifar Lazouski, Lars Damen, Roy Hoffmans, Dejan Petrovic, Kathleen C. Alexander
pmc-13099124.description: The genotoxic potential of a mixture of short-, medium-, and long-chain triacylglycerides (SMLCT), a novel synthetic fat intended as a non-animal alternative for food applications, was evaluated using a standard battery of in vitro assays in accordance with OECD Test Guidelines.

pmc-13173398.title: Bottom‐Up Programming of Cell States in Cancer Organoids with Defined Synthetic Adhesion Cues
pmc-13173398.creator: Ali Nadernezhad, Verena J Kast, Dagmar Pette, Franziska Baenke, Daniel E Stange, Carsten Werner, Daniela Loessner
pmc-13173398.description: Despite advances in defined culture systems, current organoid models lack programmable control of transcriptomic states beyond fixed genetic constraints or broadly specific microenvironmental conditions. Here, a bottom‐up biomaterial‐based platform is introduced to program cell state changes in pancreatic cancer organoids by tuning minimal adhesion cues within a synthetic matrix.

pmc-13198201.title: Integrative analysis of blood biochemistry and sperm metabolome profiles reveals metabolic determinants of cryotolerance in Bali bulls under standardized nutritional conditions
pmc-13198201.creator: Zulfi Nur Amrina Rosyada, Hikmayani Iskandar, Mohammad Anam Al Arif, Widya Paramita Lokapirnasari, Rimayanti, Siti Rani Ayuti, Herry Sonjaya, Erni Damayanti, Ananda Ananda, Hendri Hendri, Muhamad Aldi Nurdiansyah, Tulus Maulana, Erdogan Memili, Mirni Lamid
pmc-13198201.description: BackgroundEnhancing the nation’s beef supply and guaranteeing long-term food security require increasing the effectiveness of artificial insemination (AI) in Bali cattle (Bos javanicus). Cryotolerance, or post-thaw variability in semen quality, limits AI results and probably reflects systemic and cellular metabolic variations.

pmc-13239555.title: Exercise Effect on Cerebral Artery Hemodynamic and Morphology in Stroke Patients: A Randomized Trial
pmc-13239555.creator: Simon Takadiyi Gunda, Ziman Chen, Jerica Hiu‐Yui Yip, Veronica Tsam‐Kit Ng, Xinyang Han, Jingguo Qu, Xiangyan Chen, Michael Tin‐Cheung Ying, Marco Yiu‐Chung Pang
pmc-13239555.description: AimsStroke is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide and occurs primarily due to impaired cerebrovascular health. Aerobic exercise training (AET) has the potential to improve deconditioned cerebrovascular status in post‐stroke patients, but its utility remains underexplored. This study assessed the effects of AET on cerebral artery morphology and hemodynamics in post‐stroke patients using advanced ultrasonography techniques.

pmc-13304875.title: Modern Drug Delivery Platforms Based on Photocrosslinkable Hydrogels (PCHs) in Dentistry: From Material Characteristics to Clinical Applications—A Review
pmc-13304875.creator: Susanna Sologova, Diana Sologova, Anna Shumkina, Vera Brazhnikova, Victoria Morozova, Sergey Sologov, Sergey Rusanov, George Anikin, Raisa Chilova, Elena Smolyarchuk, Elena Bakhrushina
pmc-13304875.description: Background/Objectives: Modern dentistry increasingly requires biomaterials that not only replace damaged tissues but also actively regulate healing processes, modulate inflammation, and provide controlled delivery of therapeutic agents under the complex physicochemical conditions of the oral cavity. This review aims to analyze the potential of PCHs, particularly methacryloyl gelatin (GelMA), as multifunctional platforms for drug delivery in dental applications.

pmc-13364587.title: Development and validation of multidimensional nomograms for predicting prostate cancer risk: a retrospective study
pmc-13364587.creator: Tao Zhang, Xue Li, Junsong Zeng, Maosen Xu, Yan Tie
pmc-13364587.description: BackgroundPSA screening has limited specificity in the 10–20 ng/mL range, making biopsy decisions difficult. Metabolic disorders and inflammation may improve risk prediction. We aimed to develop a model integrating multidimensional indicators to predict prostate cancer and high−grade disease in men with tPSA >10 ng/mL.MethodsThis retrospective study included 461 men who underwent prostate biopsy (tPSA >10 ng/mL).

pmc-13487101.title: Does Conventional Radiography Overrepresent Joint Space Narrowing in Hallux Rigidus? A Comparative Study With Weightbearing CT Imaging
pmc-13487101.creator: Ahmed Saleh, Vineel Mallavarapu, Nacime Salomao Barbachan Mansur, Aly M. Fayed, Cesar de Cesar Netto
pmc-13487101.description: Background:Conventional weightbearing radiographs are the gold standard for grading hallux rigidus (HR), yet clinical symptoms often do not correlate with radiographic severity. This study compared 2-dimensional (2D) weightbearing radiographs with weightbearing computed tomography (WBCT) to evaluate if traditional imaging overrepresents joint degeneration.Methods:A retrospective study of 21 patients (13 males; average age 55.9 years) with HR was conducted.

pmc-13519545.title: Cerebral and cervical hemodynamic differences in adolescents with first-episode depressive disorder: a TCCD and cervical artery ultrasound study
pmc-13519545.creator: Yihan Leng, Xinyue Wang, Xiaoqing Wang, Pingzi Wang, Jiaming Luo, Na Li, Litao Ye, Ling Li, You Yang, Yang Li, Jinhong Yu
pmc-13519545.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo investigate cerebral and cervical hemodynamic differences assessed by transcranial color-coded duplex sonography (TCCD) combined with cervical artery ultrasound in adolescents with first-episode depressive disorder.MethodsThis study included 169 adolescents with first-episode depressive disorder and 61 healthy controls. TCCD combined with cervical artery ultrasound was used to assess hemodynamic parameters of the main cerebral and cervical arteries, including peak systolic velocity, end-diastolic velocity, mean velocity, pulsatility index, and resistance index. Differences between the depressive disorder group and the healthy control group were compared.
